title: Marketing Director
description: Make Tethos's work visible through content, campaigns and creative projects.

essay_questions.question: How might you be successful in this role?
(optional, recommended) Please share a link to your design portfolio with us. Make sure the link shared is viewable!
Tell us about a project or piece of work you’re really proud of.
What two fonts best represent you and why?

title: Internal Director
description: Help the team feel connected through member experience, events and internal operations.

essay_questions.question: Propose a social event for our club! Tell us what you’d plan and how you’d make it happen.
Participation is one of our biggest challenges, as students are often too busy to attend events. How would you encourage students to get involved despite their busy schedules?
Jack (our PMO) has officially announced that he will NOT be attending the TSI pedicure social. Your mission: change his mind. What are you saying to convince him to come?

title: External Director
description: Build relationships with partners, sponsors and the communities our projects serve.

essay_questions.question: Why do you want to apply to External?
Tell us about something you’re passionate about! Convince us to try it.
Despite it being our 1st time running GENESIS, we achieved 250+ attendees in students, professors, and corporate sponsors. How would you expand GENESIS to reach even more people?
Situation Question: You are 2 weeks away from GENESIS and notice there’s only 1 food sponsor secured willing to serve up to 50 attendees. Knowing there are 300+ signups, what would you do?

title: Developer
description: Build useful software with a project team for a nonprofit client.

essay_questions.question: Why do you want to be a developer at TSI?
Tell us about something you've built or explored that you're proud of; it doesn't have to be a school project or anything technical.
TSI is a real-time commitment. How do you plan to balance it with everything else on your plate?
Tell us something you're genuinely passionate about. Anything.
